mr_title: Implement access token context encoding framework
mr_description:
- Encoding context to access token IDs closes
- Shorter encoding of access token

expected_issues.title: In AccessTokenContext constructor, the fourth Objects.requireNonNull validates grantType…
expected_issues.description: In AccessTokenContext constructor, the fourth Objects.requireNonNull validates grantType twice instead of validating rawTokenId, allowing null rawTokenId values to pass validation.
expected_issues.source_text: In AccessTokenContext constructor, the fourth Objects.requireNonNull validates grantType twice instead of validating rawTokenId, allowing null rawTokenId values to pass validation.

expected_issues.description: In isAccessTokenId, the substring for the grant shortcut and the equality check look inverted: the grant shortcut occupies indices 4–5 (substring(4,6)), and a match should return true (combined with UUID check), not false.
